_instructions: Monthly USD cost per service for anything the weekly audit can't pull by API. Edit on main; the collector converts to a weekly figure (x 7/30.44). Leave a value null if unknown; it shows up as a blind spot in the report. Update 'as_of' when you change numbers.

revenuecat.where: RevenueCat → Billing. Use monthly_usd for a flat bill, or pct_of_revenue (e.g. 0.01) to estimate from tracked revenue

openai.note: Used only when OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY is not set, to estimate transcription cost from audio minutes
